what_this_is: The catalogue screens the generic screen host answers (GET /work/api/screens/<id> is the row tool:<id> here): each row’s screen is { kind: "reads", reads: [{ id, tool, input }], shown_when?, layout }, moved from old trillion records/marketplace-screens.json (tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire). The host runs each read as that tool’s run for the asking account and draws the layout from what the reads answered.

payload.label: Look
payload.job: Show how Trillion looks and feels on every screen this account opens it on: the look it wears, how panes size and snap, and how each moment feels
payload.description: A screen with no facts to read: three sections that lend the shared parts that keep their own choice in the account’s records (Screen look, Panes, Feel). It runs nothing: the screen host draws its layout as it is (GET /work/api/screens/look).

layout.title: Look
layout.lead: How Trillion looks and feels on every screen you open it on.

sections.heading: Screen look
sections.body: Choose a look. Changes appear right away.

sections.heading: Panes
sections.body: Drag the edge to feel it. Changes appear right away.

sections.heading: Feel
sections.body: How each moment feels: the touch, the sound and the motion. Press play to feel one.
